annotations.title: Image ads, motion graphics and templates

description: Marketing Studio templates beyond video ads. templates lists them free with real example outputs. image applies an image template to a product: static ads, product shots, posters, marketplace listings (pure white for Amazon/Shopify), UGC photos, headline spelled exactly, 1-8 at a time at the engine price; with reference_ad_url it rebuilds an existing ad with this product (ad multiplier). motion renders code-built motion graphics with exact words, brand colors and logo: kinetic-headline, feature-callouts, count-up, price-drop, logo-sting (2 credits each). end_card adds the brand logo, tagline and button after a finished video ad (1 credit per 30 s). The brand kit (pixeldojo_brand_kit) fills colors, logo, headline and selling points unless brand_kit: false.

action.description: templates = free list (filter by kind, category). image = image template on a product. motion = code-rendered motion graphic. end_card = brand end card after a finished ad (video_url). status = check a motion render (motion_id).

aspect_ratio.description: Default: the template's own (motion 9:16; 4:5 renders 9:16 there).

brand_kit.description: false skips the brand kit for this call.

brand_name.description: motion: the brand shown when there is no logo. Default: the brand kit.

category.description: templates: product-shot, motion, ugc, tiktok, ads, posters or marketplace.

character_image_urls.description: image: your own character (e.g. from pixeldojo_library source characters) for templates with a person.

colors.description: motion: #RRGGBB, lead color first. Default: the brand kit.

direction.description: image: extra art direction added to the template.

engine.description: image: default nano-banana-pro (4.5 credits); nano-banana-2-1 is 1.5; ideogram-4-5 2 for poster type.

headline.description: Exact words on the ad. Blank uses the brand kit tagline.

motion_id.description: status: the id a motion or end_card call returned.

points.description: Selling points on the ad. Blank uses the brand kit.

product_description.description: Short product description when there is no product_url.

product_image_paths.description: Local product photos instead of URLs; uploaded first.

product_image_urls.description: Product photos. motion uses the first, cut out automatically.

product_name.description: Product name when there is no product_url (with product_image_urls).

product_url.description: image: product page; name, description and photos are read from it.

reference_ad_url.description: image ad multiplier: an image ad to rebuild with this product and your words. For a video ad use pixeldojo_ad reference_video_url.

template.description: image: an image template id from templates (e.g. stacked-shout, pure-white, ice-float). motion: kinetic-headline, feature-callouts, count-up, price-drop, logo-sting.

video_url.description: end_card: the finished ad (a PixelDojo result).
